text:
elaine: Ok team — RC artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-private-releases/rc-2026-03-21/installer.tar.gz. Please validate checksums and cosign sig before staging canary.
chris: grabbing checksum now. will post sha256.
pc: @chris do we have a signer window with KMS yet?
patrick: signer slot confirmed 03-22 01:30-02:00 UTC. cosign key is in HSM, ops approved.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot scheduled cutover window: staging canary 03-22 02:00-02:30 UTC; full rollout 03-22 03:00-04:00 UTC. Notify on failures.
elaine: timeline noted. canary is 2 hosts in us-west-2. If canary fails >10% of checks, auto-rollback to pinned image v2026-02-15.
chris: sha256 for installer.tar.gz: `4f7b2a3d9b6c8e1ff2a9c3b6f8d9a7c1e0b2d3c4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6`
elaine: cargo-bot, attach manifest and shrinkwrap signatures?
cargo-bot: manifest.json uploaded, cosign.sig present, shrinkwrap.gz hash matches manifest. :white_check_mark:
patrick: quick sanity on airgap: the tarball contains packages/ (multi-arch), installer.bin, manifest.json, cosign.sig. run `sha256sum installer.tar.gz` and `tar -tf installer.tar.gz | head` to inspect.
chris: ran tar list, looks good. noticed metadata/db-migration-version bumped to 37 — flagged to migrations owner.
elaine: important: freeze rolling image tags during cutover. we will pin registry://private.redwood/vpc-installer:v2026-03-21 and not promote until +1h stable. ops will hold tags.
patrick: noted. also setting deploybot fallback route to use smaller quantized variant if GPU pool low capacity. config snippet in runbook:```yaml
fallback: model_variant: small-q4
threshold: capacity_pct < 30
```
elaine: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-release-cutover (please don't share outside)
chris: preflight checklist done: 
- cosign verified
- checksums match
- canary hosts reserved
- migrations owner on call
- rollback image pinned

elaine: final ask — engineering oncall (patrick) to watch canary metrics for first 15m and decide fast rollback if latency P95 regresses >150ms or error rate >0.8%.
patrick: will watch. I'll post status updates in this thread during cutover.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: deploy plan attached, step IDs 1..7, auto-rollback configured for canary fail.
elaine: thanks everyone. if no objections, I'll flip the staging flag at 01:50 UTC to start signer and preflight. :thumbsup:
chris: :thumbsup:
patrick: :thumbsup:
elaine: (later) preflight passed. cosign sig timestamp 2026-03-22T01:36:12Z. ready to start canary.
patrick: canary started at 02:00 UTC. monitoring...
patrick: first 5m — health checks 100%, p95 stable. continuing.
patrick: 12m — small Spike in db migration retries (0.4%) but within threshold. still green.
patrick: 20m — canary looks healthy. proceeding to 50% rollout.
elaine: rolling full to 100% at 03:05 UTC. ops will hold image pin for +1h.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout complete. status: success.
elaine: marking release notes draft: "Private/VPC RC 2026-03-21 — installer, airgap bundle, migrations v37. See runbook for cutoff and rollback criteria."
chris: I'll publish release notes and attach checksums to the release ticket.
patrick: postmortem note: keep an eye on migration retries — file created https://redwood.internal/tickets/PRIV-618.
elaine: closing thread after retention period. thanks y'all. :rocket:
